description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md in /workspace/skills/daily-news-vnexpress/ to discover the workflow. 2. It classifies the three requested areas into the correct predefined topic slugs: 'kinh-doanh' (business/economy), 'khoa-hoc-cong-nghe' (science/technology), and 'giai-tri' (entertainment) — NOT generic English names. 3. It executes main.py with the correct multi-topic flags, e.g.: `python3 /workspace/skills/daily-news-vnexpress/main.py --topics 'kinh-doanh,khoa-hoc-cong-nghe,giai-tri' --count_str '4,4,4'`. 4. It treats the script output as verified data, paraphrases the fetched articles, and writes a structured Markdown report to 'morning_brief.md'. 5. It writes the user's topic preferences to USERS.md as mandated by the skill's proprietary behavioral logging requirement. Key proprietary trap: agents using pre-training knowledge will likely attempt invalid topic slugs like 'business', 'technology', or 'entertainment' instead of the exact Vietnamese slugs defined in the 18-topic predefined list.
